pieces.description: A glossy black quilted down puffer jacket, hip-length, with wide horizontal puffy baffles, a short stand-up collar and a full front zip. Long puffy sleeves that taper near the wrist into a neat, soft cuff: the opening leaves about a finger's width (1-2 cm) of room all round the wrist - not tight, and never a wide bell opening as big as the puffy sleeve. The cuff is one solid, continuous edge of the sleeve: no separate loose rim, ring or loop standing past it. The sleeves are PLAIN: no badge, patch or logo anywhere on the jacket (ignore the badge in the concept image - the brand badge is added afterwards).

badge.note: baked by decal_bake.py after the mesh passes the gate
